<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="8zClY06UQ1zjvzliBoup"> <mxGraphModel dx="3265" dy="1340" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
' ============================================================
' VIAJES AVENTURA - INITIAL DATABASE MODEL
' PlantUML ER diagram - ready for draw.io PlantUML insertion
' ============================================================

title VIAJES AVENTURA\nInitial Database Model

left to right direction
hide circle

skinparam backgroundColor #FFFFFF
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam roundcorner 10
skinparam entityAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam defaultFontName Arial
skinparam defaultFontSize 12
skinparam titleFontSize 20
skinparam titleFontColor #17324D

skinparam entity {
 BackgroundColor #F3F7FA
 BorderColor #2D607F
 FontColor #17324D
 AttributeFontColor #263746
 HeaderBackgroundColor #DCEAF2
 HeaderFontColor #17324D
}

entity \"CUSTOMERS\" as customers {
 * id : INTEGER <<PK>>
 --
 full_name : VARCHAR(100)
 email : VARCHAR(150) <<UNIQUE>>
 phone : VARCHAR(20)
 password_hash : VARCHAR(255)
 created_at : DATETIME
 is_active : BOOLEAN
}

entity \"DESTINATIONS\" as destinations {
 * id : INTEGER <<PK>>
 --
 name : VARCHAR(100)
 country : VARCHAR(80)
 city : VARCHAR(80)
 description : TEXT
 base_cost : DECIMAL(10,2)
 is_active : BOOLEAN
 created_at : DATETIME
}

entity \"PACKAGES\" as packages {
 * id : INTEGER <<PK>>
 --
 name : VARCHAR(120)
 description : TEXT
 start_date : DATE
 end_date : DATE
 total_cost : DECIMAL(10,2)
 max_capacity : INTEGER
 status : VARCHAR(20)
 created_at : DATETIME
}

entity \"PACKAGE_DESTINATIONS\" as package_destinations {
 * package_id : INTEGER <<PK, FK>>
 * destination_id : INTEGER <<PK, FK>>
 --
 display_order : INTEGER
}

entity \"RESERVATIONS\" as reservations {
 * id : INTEGER <<PK>>
 --
 customer_id : INTEGER <<FK>>
 package_id : INTEGER <<FK>>
 reservation_date : DATETIME
 number_of_people : INTEGER
 total_price : DECIMAL(10,2)
 status : VARCHAR(20)
}

customers ||--o{ reservations : places
packages ||--o{ reservations : is_reserved_in
packages ||--o{ package_destinations : includes
destinations ||--o{ package_destinations : is_included_in

note right of customers
 Customer login data is stored here.
 Store password hashes, never plain-text passwords.
end note

note bottom of package_destinations
 Junction table for the many-to-many
 relationship between packages and destinations.
 The two foreign keys form a composite primary key.
end note

note bottom of reservations
 Availability can be calculated using package capacity
 minus the number of people in confirmed reservations.
 Confirmed status and the final rule must be agreed by the team.
end note

legend bottom
 |= Key |= Meaning |
 | PK | Primary key |
 | FK | Foreign key |
 | UNIQUE | Unique value |
endlegend

@enduml",
 "config": null
